title: Design a Word Dictionary
description: Design a data structure that supports adding new words and finding if a string matches any previously added string, where '.' can match any letter.
input_format: First line contains integer `m`. Following `m` lines contain `ADD word` or `SEARCH word`.
output_format: Outputs of SEARCH commands (true/false) separated by space.

sample_tests.input:
5
ADD bad
ADD dad
ADD mad
SEARCH pad
SEARCH .ad

3
ADD cat
SEARCH c.t
SEARCH d.t

hints: Use a Trie to store words.
When encountering '.', recursively check all child branches of the current Trie node.
Base case: string fully consumed and current node marks end of word.
